integrity: Analytic proof with reproducible finite edge-crossing diagnostics; numerical checks do not certify all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Fixed centered right prisms with regular even-gon bases of at least six sides; Haar-uniform central normals only. Maximum-side probability, optimal height, and large-order limit, not complete section-law or all-prism universality; historical-priority risks remain. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp maximal-section probability and aspect-ratio rigidity for regular even-gon prisms
